9907-the-raid-from-beausejour-and-how-th.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The French soldiers were talking in loud, excited tones. As they spoke a tallish lad drew near and listened eagerly. The boy, who was apparently about sixteen or seventeen years of age, was clad in the rough, yellow-gray homespun cloth of the Acadians. His name was Pierre Lecorbeau, and he had just come from the village of Beaubassin to carry eggs, milk, and cheeses to the camp on Beauséjour.

arxiv-2111-08633.title: Evolution of low-lying M1 modes in germanium isotopes
arxiv-2111-08633.creator: S. Frauendorf, R. Schwengner
arxiv-2111-08633.description: Abstract Magnetic dipole strength functions are determined for the series of germanium isotopes from N = Z = 32 N=Z=32 to N N = 48 on the basis of a large number of transition strengths calculated within the shell model.

arxiv-2301-10080.title: Practical Synchronization for OTFS This publication has emanated from research conducted with the financial support of Science Foundation Ireland under Grant number 19/FFP/7005(T).
arxiv-2301-10080.creator: Mohsen Bayat, Sanoopkumar P. S., and Arman Farhang
arxiv-2301-10080.description: Abstract In the existing literature on joint timing and frequency synchronization of orthogonal time frequency space modulation (OTFS), practically infeasible impulse pilot with large peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) is deployed. Hence, in this paper, we propose a timing offset (TO) and carrier frequency offset (CFO) estimation for OTFS over a linear time-varying (LTV) channel, using a low PAPR pilot structure.

arxiv-2311-10494.title: Using the critical set to induce bifurcations
arxiv-2311-10494.creator: O. Kaminski, D. S. Monteiro, C. Tomei
arxiv-2311-10494.description: Abstract For a function F : X → Y F:X\to Y between real Banach spaces, we show how continuation methods to solve F ⁡ ( u ) = g F(u)=g may improve from basic understanding of the critical set 𝒞 {\mathcal{C}} of F F .

arxiv-2411-12349.title: Spin-density wave and superconductivity in La 4 Ni 3 O 10 under ambient pressure
arxiv-2411-12349.creator: Ming Zhang, Hongyi Sun, Yu-Bo Liu, Qihang Liu, Wei-Qiang Chen, Fan Yang
arxiv-2411-12349.description: Abstract We investigate the spin-density wave (SDW) behavior and the potential for superconductivity (SC) in La 4 Ni 3 O 10 under ambient pressure using a multi-orbital random-phase approximation (RPA). Starting with a twelve-orbital tight-binding model derived from density functional theory (DFT) calculations, we explore the influence of Hubbard interactions on SDW formation.

arxiv-2508-19000.title: Beyond-Diagonal RIS: Adversarial Channels and Optimality of Low-Complexity Architectures
arxiv-2508-19000.creator: Atso Iivanainen, Robin Rajamäki, and Visa Koivunen
arxiv-2508-19000.description: Abstract Beyond-diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (BD-RISs) have recently gained attention as an enhancement to conventional RISs. BD-RISs allow optimizing not only the phase, but also the amplitude responses of their discrete surface elements by introducing adjustable inter-element couplings. Various BD-RIS architectures have been proposed to optimally trade off between average performance and complexity of the architecture.

plos-pone-0010778.description: PLOS ONE research article. The role of mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress has been extensively characterized in the aetiology of sarcopenia (aging-associated loss of muscle mass) and muscle wasting as a result of muscle disuse. pmc-10695591.title: Radiographical presentations of inadvertent subdural placement of an epidural catheter for successful labor analgesia: A case report
pmc-10695591.creator: Wei-An Chen, Ming-Cheng Wu, Chen-Fuh Lam, Chang-Hsien Ou
pmc-10695591.description: Rationale:Lumbar epidural analgesia is the gold standard for labor pain control. However, misplacement of epidural catheters into the subdural space may inadvertently happen. Unrecognized subdural administration of local anesthetics could result in serious consequences, including high spinal and brainstem blocks.

pmc-11463131.title: Leveraging large-scale datasets and single cell omics data to develop a polygenic score for cisplatin-induced ototoxicity
pmc-11463131.creator: Deanne Nixie R. Miao, MacKenzie A. P. Wilke, John Pham, Feryal Ladha, Mansumeet Singh, Janilyn Arsenio, Emilia Luca, Alain Dabdoub, Wejian Yang, Jun J. Yang, Britt I. Drögemöller
pmc-11463131.description: BackgroundCisplatin-induced ototoxicity (CIO), characterized by irreversible and progressive bilateral hearing loss, is a prevalent adverse effect of cisplatin chemotherapy. Alongside clinical risk factors, genetic variants contribute to CIO and genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have highlighted the polygenicity of this adverse drug reaction.

pmc-12506369.title: High fat diet exacerbated glycolipid metabolism disorder in kidney Yang deficiency rats by interfering with IRS 1-PI3K (p85) -Akt-GLUT 4 pathway
pmc-12506369.creator: Han Li, Yunqiao Wang, Wei Zheng, Jing Lu, Cuiyao Tang, Mengyang Long, Bo Liu, Bin Chen, Weihong Li, Zihui Xu
pmc-12506369.description: BackgroundKidney Yang deficiency (KYD) is associated with disturbances in glucose and lipid metabolism. This study examined whether KYD rats on a high-fat diet (HFD) exhibit aggravated metabolic dysfunction and sought to elucidate the underlying mechanisms.MethodsThree-week-old SD rats were assigned to control (Con), KYD, HFD, and KYD + HFD groups.

pmc-12625877.title: Associations between heart failure-related quality of life and clinical parameters in patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: a cross-sectional analysis of data from a multicentre Japanese registry
pmc-12625877.creator: Masao Saotome, Keitaro Akita, Shigetaka Kageyama, Sayumi Suzuki, Kazuto Ohno, Masamitsu Kamakura, Ryuzo Nawada, Chiei Takanaka, Yasushi Wakabayashi, Takahiro Kanda, Kei Tawarahara, Masahiro Muto, Masaki Matsunaga, Satoru Suwa, Yasuyo Takeuchi, Hiroki Sakamoto, Hideki Saito, Kazusa Hayashi, Nobuyuki
pmc-12625877.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the relationship between a quality of life (QOL) score and clinical parameters in patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM).DesignA multicentre cross-sectional study.SettingWe analysed data from the Searching for Atrial Fibrillation and Early Recruitment of Heart Failure in HCM registry, collected between 2018 and 2023.ParticipantsPatients with HCM (n=499) aged ≥18 years from 12 institutions (Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan) were consecutively enrolled.

pmc-12864924.title: Robust chirality-induced spin selectivity in topologically chiral molecular knots
pmc-12864924.creator: Xi Sun, Kai-Yuan Zhang, Shu-Zheng Zhou, Hua-Hua Fu
pmc-12864924.description: Molecular knots with topological chirality demonstrate superior spin selectivity compared to conventional chiral materials, exhibiting ultra-high spin polarization of nearly 90%, conductivity increased by two orders of magnitude and high-temperature stability (up to 350°C). However, the physical origin of this phenomenon remains elusive.

pmc-13006518.title: In situ muscle pre-activation shifts the lateral gastrocnemius muscle–tendon unit to rely on active fascicle lengthening to absorb peak power input
pmc-13006518.creator: Daisey Vega, Christopher J. Arellano
pmc-13006518.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Muscle–tendon units (MTUs) tend to exploit their elastic elements to meet a range of energy-absorption and power input demands, but the extent of this may depend on how the muscle produces force. Muscle pre-activation is a habitual strategy observed in vivo during energy-absorbing demands, but it remains a question whether pre-activation alters the power input demands among elastic elements and muscle fascicles.

pmc-13114727.title: Routine Biomarkers in Paediatric Appendicitis Stratification: Which Add Diagnostic Value? A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13114727.creator: Ciprian-Ioan Borca, Alexandru Alexandru, Madalin-Marius Margan, Cristiana-Smaranda Ivan, Alexandru Cristian Cindrea, Corneluta Fira-Mladinescu, Marius Negru, Delia Hutanu, Silviu-Valentin Vlad, Brigitha Vlaicu, Vlad-Laurentiu David
pmc-13114727.description: Background: Preoperative differentiation between uncomplicated and complicated paediatric appendicitis remains challenging. This study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic performance of routine admission biomarkers and blood cell count-derived inflammatory indices for severity stratification and to determine whether fibrinogen provides additional predictive value beyond commonly used markers. Methods: We conducted a retrospective single-centre study (2018–2025) using electronically recorded clinical data.

pmc-13152369.title: A Case Report of Acute Appendicitis Complicated by Appendicoliths
pmc-13152369.creator: Faris F Halaseh, Lindsey C Spiegelman
pmc-13152369.description: This case report highlights the clinical complexities of diagnosing and managing appendicitis complicated by appendicoliths in a 44-year-old female patient. Appendicitis is a common cause of acute abdominal pain, with imaging playing a crucial role in diagnosis. The patient presented with symptoms of right lower quadrant pain, nausea, vomiting, and chills that were initially misattributed to menstrual cramps.

pmc-13236902.title: Optimised hybrid late fusion deep learning model for cashew disease classification
pmc-13236902.creator: Meenakshi K, Suresh Sankaranarayanan
pmc-13236902.description: IntroductionCashew farms are highly vulnerable to the attack of pests and plant diseases, which leads to massive losses in production and economic value. To diagnose the cashew disease, recent studies have explored deep learning methods; however, the existing models often have poor representative features and low generaliz-ability to different situations.

pmc-13409674.title: A Novel Magnetic Bead-Based Differential DNA Extraction Method with Potential for High-Throughput Automation in Forensic Casework: A Proof-of-Concept Study
pmc-13409674.creator: Amy-Leigh Whittaker, William P. Allan, Mark W. Perlin, Laura J. Heathfield
pmc-13409674.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: Sexual offences remain a global challenge, disproportionality affecting developing and conflict-stricken countries. Differential DNA extraction (DDE) is standardly applied to intimate swabs collected in these cases to separate and purify sperm and epithelial fractions ahead of DNA profiling. Whilst DNA purification steps using magnetic bead technology are routinely automated in general forensic workflows, the separation step within DDE workflows usually relies on centrifugation, which is challenging to automate in a high-throughput manner.
